Raga: Madhumad Sarang
Tala: Teental
Vocal: Thake Sab Gaye Bajaye
A soulful Hindustani classical vocal rendition by Ustad Ghulam Mustafa Khan, featuring “Thake Sab Gaye Bajaye”. The performance highlights the melodic character of the raga and the artist’s expressive voice and mastery of Hindustani classical music.
